title: COPOZZ M-2181 Goggles
body_html:
﻿

Don't wind up with the short end of the stick again this season; your out of date goggles need a 2019 update. And now you don't need to break the bank for the latest in goggle technology. The COPOZZ M-2181 Goggles will improve every aspect of your ski or snowboard trip, from their Magnetic Lens Change System for fast lens changes to the OG shape. Make every move on the mountain with unbeatable vision and epic style by rocking the COPOZZ M-2181 Goggles.


All models come with a  free soft AND hard case to keep your goggles safe on and off the hill. We strongly recommend adding the low light lens to your order, to fully take advantage of the  Magnetic Lens Change System, and be ready to shred in any condition! 
With  10 super strong magnets and flexible Thermoplastic Polyurethane (TPU) material, your lenses are secure in the event of a crash or heavy fall. These are by far the  best value goggleswith   Magnetic Lens Change on the market for 18/19 season, so get in quick while stocks last!

INCLUDES

  • 1x COPOZZ M-2181 Frames
  • 1x Lens of Choice
